blocks.text: Is hisse mein kitab do sanati (industrial) tareeqe batati hai: samandar ke paani se magnesium nikalna (Dow Process, 17.7.1) aur limestone (choone ka pathar, CaCO₃) se quicklime (CaO) banana (17.7.2). Dono mein Group 2 ke aam milne wale zaraye (sources) istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Dow Process mein magnesium kis cheez se nikala jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Samandar ke paani (seawater) se, jis mein Mg²⁺ ions kam miqdar mein magar bohat bare zakheere mein maujood hain.

items: Samandar ke paani se Mg (Dow Process); limestone se CaO (lime kiln).
